title: SELECTION OF Architects / Architectural Firms for providing architectural designs and services towards Development of Research Park and associated facilities at IIT Bhilai
scope_summary: IIT Bhilai invites proposals from architects/architectural firms for providing design services for their Research Park and associated facilities. The scope includes BIM modeling, sustainability assessment, quantity surveying, and cost estimation, with a focus on advanced design and coordination platforms.

title: INTERIOR DECORATION AND AESTHETIC UPLIFTMENT OF LOBBY AREA OF OFFICE OF R&D, IIT Kharagpur
scope_summary: IIT Kharagpur invites bids for interior decoration and aesthetic upliftment of the Lobby Area of the Office of R&D. The scope includes space planning, 2D layout, 3D design, and virtual walkthroughs.

title: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of IoT-based Ultrasonic-type Digital water meters Confirming to ISO:4064-2014 for water supply lines to the additional Buildings at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy.
scope_summary: IIT Hyderabad invites bids for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of IoT-based ultrasonic digital water meters for new buildings. The system should support data logging, transmission, and internal storage for a minimum of one year.

title: Framework agreement of topographical survey gpr survey bathymetric survey and geotechnical investigation for upcoming projects.
scope_summary: This tender seeks an agency for a framework agreement covering topographical surveys, GPR surveys, bathymetric surveys, and geotechnical investigations for upcoming projects in the power sector.

title: Tender for preparing the estimate for the work of item no. 1 adivali small irrigation scheme, tal. shahapur, dist. thane dam safety, on a pilot basis, measuring the dam with lider technology, structural audit and digitization 3d laser scanning etc.
scope_summary: This tender is for preparing an estimate for dam safety work at Adivali Small Irrigation Scheme, Thane, Maharashtra. The work includes measuring the dam with LiDAR technology, structural audit, and digitization through 3D laser scanning.

title: Supply of AR/VR based emotion evoking experimental kit
scope_summary: This tender is for the supply of an AR/VR based emotion evoking experimental kit for a PSU in Delhi.
